body.statement: At the exact tie \(h=0\), uniformly for every \(n,m\ge1\), \[\ell_{n,m}(0)\asymp k\min\{a_m,m^{1/4}/\sqrt n\},\] with constants depending only on \(\delta_0\) and \(c_0\). The lower bound is obtained from a balanced-sign composite mixture and the upper bound from an explicit capped quadratic \(U\)-statistic interval that remains valid with empty cells.
body.justification: The tie is the main nonregular benchmark and shows why zero smoothing bias does not imply zero statistical uncertainty.
body.gap: CaiLow2011 gives an absolute-functional point-risk lower bound, not a finite-sample honest connected-interval oracle under binomial occupancy.
body.consumer: It quantifies the uncertainty hidden by fixed-temperature standard errors at crossover cells.
